senses.sense_definition: mensen informatie verschaffen over iets dat ze zich onvoldoende realiseren; mensen iets laten beseffen

examples.text: De leraar probeert de leerlingen te <w>bewustmaken</w> van de gevaren van sociale media.

target_lang_translations.en: The teacher is trying to <w>make</w> the students <w>aware</w> of the dangers of social media.

examples.text: We willen ouderen <w>bewustmaken</w> van de gevolgen van overmatig alcoholgebruik.

target_lang_translations.en: We want to <w>raise awareness</w> among the elderly about the consequences of excessive alcohol consumption.

target_lang_definitions.en: To provide people with information about something they do not sufficiently realize; to make people aware of something.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to inform someone about a situation or fact
to increase knowledge or understanding of an issue
to make someone sensitive to or aware of something
